abstracts.abstract: Senate, July 13, 2026  -- The committee on Municipalities and Regional Government to whom was referred the petition (accompanied by bill, Senate, No. 1433) of Julian Cyr for legislation relative to zoning for multi-family housing production, report the accompanying bill (Senate, No. 3157).

bill.title: An Act relative to zoning for housing production

action.description: Bill reported favorably by committee and referred to the committee on Senate Ways and Means

related_entities.name: the committee on Senate Ways and Means
committee on Senate Ways and Means

posted_text:
🏗️ Housing
MA S3157 — Your town could get a big boost in housing – but with a catch

New rules say cities over 10,000 people need to allow multi-family homes as a ‘right,’ with a minimum density of 15 units per acre. Failing to comply could mean missing out on state housing funds – and the state will keep a close eye on how cities follow the rules.

July 13, 2026: Bill reported favorably by committee and referred to the committee on Senate Ways and Means.
